Half of this set is aimed at the three fields at +0x14..+0x16, because those are the ones the header called `pad_14[3]` until this constructor was read: if they were transposed, or read from the wrong parameter, nothing else in the tree would notice -- neither reader touches them.  The other half is the four constants, where the failure mode is a store dropped entirely rather than a value got wrong.
